post.title: Netflix's Standard plan went from $7.99 to $19.99
post.ig:
Netflix's Standard plan went from $7.99 to $19.99.
US Standard (ad-free) cost $7.99 in 2013 and $13.99 by 2020; it rose to $15.49 (Jan 2022), $17.99 (Jan 2025) and $19.99 (March 2026).
Netflix reports Q3 results on Tuesday, October 20. Its own forecast: $12.86 billion in revenue, up 12%, driven by memberships, pricing and ad revenue.
The ad plan is $8.99: $11 a month less than Standard, or $132 a year.
Sources: Netflix Q2 2026 shareholder letter, CBS News, NBC News, Tom's Guide.
